title: About — Inovexa ERP | A Tunisian ERP, by MSAI Systems
description: Inovexa ERP is 100% online business software, designed in Tunis by MSAI Systems for Tunisian businesses: invoicing, stock, accounting, payroll.

title: An ERP designed in Tunis, for Tunisian businesses

c: Inovexa ERP is published by MSAI Systems. Our goal: to give small and medium-sized businesses a complete management tool that is easy to start with, complies with Tunisian rules and has a clear price in dinars.

title: A serious management tool, within reach of small businesses
lead: Many businesses still run their sales in a spreadsheet, their stock in another file and their payroll somewhere else. Inovexa ERP brings everything into one place, where each operation updates the rest: stock, accounts and dashboards.

c: VAT, stamp duty, withholding tax, the TEIF file for El Fatoora, payroll with CNSS and IRPP, amounts to the millime.
You choose your sector and your modules are ready. Nothing to install, no server to maintain.
Plans in dinars, shown on the site. You try before you pay and you cancel whenever you want.
The interface is available in French, English, Spanish and Arabic.
An assistant to query your data, alerts and sales forecasts based on your history, with no made-up figures.
You export your data to Excel or PDF from the modules, whenever you want.

title: MSAI Systems
lead: Inovexa ERP is developed and published by MSAI Systems, in Tunis. We build the product and support our customers: set-up, data migration and team training.
